description: Orchestraty's hooks: each runs the hook script orch init installs in Orchestraty's state folder, with the interpreter orch init names in hooks/plugin.txt there. Without that file they do nothing.

hooks.command: s=$ORCH_HOME; if [ -z "$s" ]; then if [ "$OS" = Windows_NT ]; then s=$USERPROFILE/.orchestraty; else case $XDG_STATE_HOME in /*) s=$XDG_STATE_HOME/orchestraty;; *) s=$HOME/.local/state/orchestraty;; esac; fi; fi; { IFS= read -r p; } 2>/dev/null <"$s/hooks/plugin.txt" && [ -x "$p" ] && [ -f "$s/hooks/hook.py" ] && exec "$p" -S -I "$s/hooks/hook.py" claude SessionStart; exit 0

s=$ORCH_HOME; if [ -z "$s" ]; then if [ "$OS" = Windows_NT ]; then s=$USERPROFILE/.orchestraty; else case $XDG_STATE_HOME in /*) s=$XDG_STATE_HOME/orchestraty;; *) s=$HOME/.local/state/orchestraty;; esac; fi; fi; { IFS= read -r p; } 2>/dev/null <"$s/hooks/plugin.txt" && [ -x "$p" ] && [ -f "$s/hooks/hook.py" ] && exec "$p" -S -I "$s/hooks/hook.py" claude SessionEnd; exit 0
